# Helena MetalCare — getting to know a sister's schizophrenia

> Knowing schizophrenia by walking alongside it — voices as audio, medication analysis, a doctor's counsel. Part of the Helena care track. Not medical advice.

- [Repository](https://github.com/helena751107/helena-metalcare)
- [Web MCP](https://helena751107.github.io/helena-metalcare/#mcp) — 30 tools (care.status · care.open · care.search · care.levels … plus onto.enter · onto.focus · onto.filter · onto.camera …) for agents; window.__webmcp fallback
- [3D ontology](https://helena751107.github.io/helena-metalcare/) — the landing page itself is a WebGPU knowledge graph: 36 entities, 81 relations, eight stations; WebGL2 fallback; the text webzine stays one click away
- [Live site (Korean)](https://helena751107.github.io/helena-metalcare/)
- [README](https://github.com/helena751107/helena-metalcare#readme)
